# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 1 token; Text — 1 token; Fills and status backgrounds — 1 token; Palette ramps and brand — 7 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 9 tokens; Radius — 6 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #fafcf8);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, #16352f);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #fafcf8;
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #fafcf8 | #16352f | Cartões, campos e a conversa de exemplo. Texto ink e mute sobre ele. |

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #102f31 | #f0f5e8 | Texto principal e títulos, sobre bg, surface e soft. Contraste mínimo 9,8:1. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--bg, #f2f6ef);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--bg, #102b28);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f2f6ef;
```

### Tokens (7)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bg` | #f2f6ef | #102b28 | Fundo da página. Texto ink, mute e brand sobre ele. |
| `--mute` | #53665e | #b2c8bc | Texto de apoio, legendas e rótulos, sobre bg e surface. Não usar sobre soft no tema claro (4,2:1). |
| `--brand` | #10634f | #83d3a9 | Botão principal, links, marcadores e símbolo. Sobre bg contrasta 6,6:1 no claro e 8,5:1 no escuro. |
| `--soft` | #c5dfa4 | #385744 | Disco do símbolo, plano em destaque e balão da pergunta. Texto ink sobre ele. |
| `--line` | #cfd9cb | #2d4c45 | Filetes e bordas decorativas de cartão. Não serve de borda de campo (use line-strong). |
| `--line-strong` | #6f877b | #6a9487 | Borda de campo, seletor e foco secundário. Contraste mínimo 3:1 sobre bg e surface. |
| `--nucleus` | #213947 | #f0f5e8 | Nêutrons do símbolo atômico. Só no logo. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 400 56px/60px "Newsreader", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display-xl); letter-spacing: -0.01em;
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display-xl` | `.display-xl`, `--text-display-xl` | 56px / 60px, letter-spacing -0.01em | 400 | `display` | Título do hero. Uma vez por página. |
| `display-lg` | `.display-lg`, `--text-display-lg` | 40px / 46px, letter-spacing -0.01em | 400 | `display` | Título de seção. |
| `display-md` | `.display-md`, `--text-display-md` | 28px / 34px | 400 | `display` | Título de bloco e preço. |
| `title` | `.title`, `--text-title` | 20px / 26px | 400 | `display` | Título de cartão e passo. |
| `body-lg` | `.body-lg`, `--text-body-lg` | 18px / 29px | 400 | `body` | Frase de apoio do hero. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 16px / 26px | 400 | `body` | Texto corrido. |
| `small` | `.small`, `--text-small` | 14px / 21px | 400 | `body` | Legendas e notas. |
| `button` | `.button`, `--text-button` | 15px / 15px | 600 | `body` | Texto de botão. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 11px / 11px, letter-spacing 0.1em | 600 | `body` | Rótulo em caixa alta sobre títulos e selos. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `--font-display` | `"Newsreader", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif` |
| `body` | `--font-body` | `"Hanken Grotesk", "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (9)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Ajuste fino. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Entre ícone e texto. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Entre itens de lista. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Padding de cartão pequeno. |
| `--space-5` | 24px | Padding de cartão e campo. |
| `--space-6` | 32px | Entre grupos. |
| `--space-7` | 48px | Entre título e conteúdo. |
| `--space-8` | 64px | Entre seções no celular. |
| `--space-9` | 96px | Entre seções no desktop. |

## Radius

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--radius-sm: 6px) */

```

### Tokens (6)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--radius-sm` | 6px | Rótulo tracejado. |
| `--radius-md` | 10px | Item de resultado. |
| `--radius-lg` | 14px | Cartão, conversa e passo. |
| `--radius-xl` | 16px | Cartão de plano. |
| `--radius-pill` | 999px | Botão, aba e selo. |
| `--radius-round` | 50% | Disco do símbolo e marcador. |
